purpose: Describe leaving a state unchanged or continuing an action without a break.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I fell asleep with the light left on.
I have been standing since morning without a break.
I had left the borrowed book unreturned.
restrictions: Often implies neglect or strain; some contexts are neutral.
mistake: つけっぱなし means leaving something on, not repeatedly switching it on.
